entities.name: Query protein
observations: 488 aa secreted protein with predicted molecular mass 55.21 kDa, theoretical pI 5.94, GRAVY -0.425, and estimated charge at pH 7 of -5.71.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8MU95 from Plodia interpunctella.
N-terminal signal peptide is consistent with secretion; Pfam CBM39 domain occurs at residues 26-127.

entities.name: Q8MU95
observations: Secreted extracellular monomer involved in recognition and aggregation of invading microorganisms and activation of the phenoloxidase cascade.
Binds beta-1,3-glucan, curdlan, laminarin, lipopolysaccharide, and lipoteichoic acid.

entities.name: Q8ISB6
observations: Reviewed Manduca sexta beta-1,3-glucan-binding protein 2; 61.5% identity over full length to the query.
Secreted monomer that binds beta-1,3-glucan and lipoteichoic acid and activates the phenoloxidase cascade.

entities.name: Q0E666
observations: Reviewed Galleria mellonella beta-1,3-glucan-binding protein 1; 57.2% identity over 99% query coverage.
Secreted hemolymph protein involved in beta-glucan recognition and phenoloxidase-cascade activation.

entities.name: Insect phenoloxidase cascade
observations: Beta-1,3-glucan-binding proteins act as upstream pattern-recognition components that activate this innate immune pathway after microbial polysaccharide recognition.
